name: NGC 4881 (Webb)
blurb: NGC 4881, an elliptical galaxy in the Coma Cluster, seen by Webb.
label: ngc4881-webb
story: An elliptical galaxy on the outskirts of the Coma Cluster. Webb studied it to sharpen the distance to the cluster, a touchstone for measuring the scale of the universe.

claims.text: NGC 4881 is an elliptical galaxy in the outskirts of the Coma Cluster
NGC-4881 is a target of Webb program 5989, imaging large elliptical galaxies in Coma
The Coma cluster is a key touchstone for the extragalactic distance scale
